mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) signal accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05 against baseline returns).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 270.0 indicates elevated inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 270.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1500) and real consumption (RSAFS > 600000) signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances (HOUST>1500 and RSAFS>600000).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%) indicate economic weakness that depresses corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 (INDPRO > 100) reflects strong manufacturing output, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 100 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1400 (HOUST < 1400) signal weak residential construction, indicating economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1400 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Inflation exceeding 270.0 (CPIAUCSL > 270) with near-zero rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) creates policy dilemma expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL>270 and FEDFUNDS<0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) increase discount rates and reduce liquidity, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05).
